backlogItem: F2 · Batch builder + phone approval UI + passkey login; F3 · Engagement; F7 · Red-team hardening
summary: F2, F3 and F7 done and green in one PR: passkey login plus approval that gates the worker, engagement in shadow mode end to end (poll → triage → plan → send tick, inbox, DM drafts), and a red-team pass that fixed real double-reply, secret-leak and location gaps. 870 tests (was 281); both simulations and the public-leak scanner run in CI. Two 5-hour usage windows closed mid-run; everything resumed from checkpoints.

needsAttention.title: Review + merge the PR, then apply migrations 0006 and 0007 on the VPS
needsAttention.detail: Order: merge → backup → migrate → docker compose up -d --build (docs/runbooks/migrations.md). 0006 backfills approved_at on existing approved/published rows so the worker gate keeps firing them; 0007 adds the engagement tables. Nothing goes live: engagement defaults to shadow, and the worker now needs both the dry-run key off and the worker live key for any real action.

needsAttention.title: Enrol your phone's passkey after deploy
needsAttention.detail: On the VPS: cd /opt/autopilot/infra && docker compose run --rm worker pnpm auth:enroll prints a 15-min code → https://<domain>/app/login → Add this device (docs/runbooks/login.md). The Caddy prompt stays as the first layer.

needsAttention.title: Decide: WORKER_LIVE in the server .env
needsAttention.detail: The worker refuses live without it and logs why. Add WORKER_LIVE=1 next to the dry-run key only when you want the always-on worker to post for real; your one-shot container run with the flag keeps working.

needsAttention.title: Run four read-only probe lines and paste the one-liners
needsAttention.detail: ./infra/probe.sh ig → comment_fields, dm_read · ./infra/probe.sh yt → scopes, comment_threads. They answer: are comment author ids present in Development mode, does DM read work (dm-poll stays off until then), is youtube.force-ssl granted (YouTube replies stay read-only until then).

needsAttention.title: Check .env.example line 5: the example time zone
needsAttention.detail: It says 'e.g. America/New_York'. If that is your real zone, change the example to Europe/London (the fixture zone). The leak scanner lets 'e.g.' examples through on purpose.

needsAttention.title: OK to remove one extra test batch in the LOCAL dev DB?
needsAttention.detail: apps/web's DB test used to create a 2099-01-05 batch per run; it now reuses one. The second one is harmless; removing rows needs your OK (non-negotiable 6), so it stays until you say so.

needsAttention.title: Lead cost share is above target
needsAttention.detail: See the report KPI (target < 25%). Run-3 plan: cap at 3 parallel implementers, fewer lead reads; see docs/prep/run-3-plan.md lessons.
